== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|A cloud [[fortress]] is a specialized type of [[cloudship]] designed for permanence rather than mobility, functioning more like a flying island. While standard models produced by the [[Ninecloud Court]] include basic propulsion and navigation systems, many features can be customized or negotiated. These structures vary significantly in appearance based on their owners; some are simple, unadorned [[stone]] buildings sitting on clouds, while others feature elaborate designs such as blocky castles, jeweled structures, or aesthetic themes like the purple-and-black style of the [[Akura clan]]. Some fortresses are massive, such as the [[Skysworn]] city of [[Stormrock]], while others serve as personal vessels or mobile sect headquarters. They are often equipped with complex networks of [[scripts]], [[constructs]], and protective magic to defend against powerful entities like [[Sages]], [[Heralds]], or [[Dreadgods]]. Despite these defenses, they can be vulnerable to intense physical force or Shadow{{!}}shadow-based attacks that can crack decks, smash through hulls, or reduce the entire structure to rubble.}}
